summary.en: This release corrects an issue that could restore an older cloud checkpoint immediately after a registered observer started a new campaign.
summary.zh: 本次更新修复了注册用户建立新游戏后，旧云端进度可能立即覆盖新存档的问题。

items.en: Starting a new campaign now remains at Level 1 instead of being restored to a previous cloud checkpoint, such as Level 43.
items.zh: 新建游戏现在会稳定停留在第 1 关，不再被第 43 关等旧云端检查点覆盖。

items.en: The main menu now waits for account and cloud-save discovery before enabling New Game, removing the synchronization race at startup.
items.zh: 主菜单会先完成账号与云存档检查，再开放“新游戏”，消除了启动阶段的同步竞态。

items.en: Campaign resets now use a dedicated, validated server path while ordinary cloud saves retain their protection against accidental progress loss.
items.zh: 新档重置现在使用独立且经过校验的服务端流程，普通云存档仍保留防止进度意外倒退的保护。

items.en: The latest formal release notice now appears once on the main screen after each version update and remains available from the account panel.
items.zh: 今后每次版本更新后，最新正式公告会在主屏幕为注册用户显示一次，并可随时从账号面板重新查看。

footer.en: Thank you for helping us keep every observing record trustworthy.
footer.zh: 感谢你帮助我们守护每一份可靠的观测记录。
